title: EvaluationContext
description: Runtime aggregate produced before LOOP(STEP 3, STEP 4). Materialized once per evaluation run; immutable thereafter. Persisted at ./runs/<eval_id>/evaluation_context.json. Never written back into contract files.

evaluation_id.description: Stable identifier for this evaluation run (UUID or timestamped slug).

selected_metrics.description: Subset of MetricRegistry chosen for this evaluation. Each entry is a snapshot reference, not the full metric body, to keep the context lean.

enriched_test_cases.description: References to enriched test cases (id only) to keep the context compact. Full bodies live in their own files.

fan_out_plan.description: Cartesian product of (test_case_id, metric_code) that STEP 4 must execute.

drivers_dir.description: Directory containing one subdirectory per runtime driver. Default './runtime-drivers/'. Overridable via EVALUATION_DRIVERS_DIR.

simulators_dir.description: Directory containing one subdirectory per user simulator. Default './simulators/'. Overridable via EVALUATION_SIMULATORS_DIR.

runtime_driver.description: Selects which runtime driver under paths.drivers_dir/<driver_id>/ STEP 3 invokes, and supplies the protocol-specific configuration that the driver's manifest config_schema validates. STEP 3 MUST validate driver_config against the chosen driver's driver.json#/config_schema BEFORE invoking the entry.

driver_id.description: MUST equal an existing subdirectory name under paths.drivers_dir. STEP 3 fails fast if not found.

driver_config.description: Protocol-specific configuration. Validated against the selected driver's driver.json#/config_schema, NOT here.

runtime_simulator.description: Selects which simulator role profile under paths.simulators_dir/<simulator_id>/ the host evaluation-expert agent loads when impersonating the customer in STEP 3. The simulator is NOT a subprocess and does NOT call any external LLM — the host agent's own LLM brain consumes the simulator's system_prompt template. There is no `simulator_config` field by design: model / temperature / api_key choices belong to the host agent's runtime, not to this contract.

simulator_id.description: MUST equal an existing subdirectory name under paths.simulators_dir. STEP 3 fails fast if not found.

prompt_overrides.description: Optional per-run overrides for prompt-template variables (e.g. tighten {{effective_max_turns}} or inject extra context). Treated as advisory hints by the host agent; never used to swap in a different LLM provider.

global_turn_cap.description: Fallback hard upper bound on customer-employee exchanges per scenario, used when a test case does not specify turn_budget.hard_max_turns. STEP 3 chooses the smaller of (test_case.turn_budget.hard_max_turns, global_turn_cap) to enforce.
